ValidationRule.description: If the record is already synced to Oracle (OraclePartyId__c is not blank), then Receipt Amount, Transaction Date, and Transaction Number must not be changed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(SalesOrder__r.Unit__r.Phase__r.CurrencyIsoCode, "AED"), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT( ISPICKVAL(SalesOrder__r.Source_Entity__c, "Modon - Egypt") ),
OR( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(OraclePartyId__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Oracle_Id_Temporary__c))) ), OR( ISCHANGED(OraclePartyId__c), ISCHANGED(Oracle_Id_Temporary__c), ISCHANGED(Receipt_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(TransactionDate__c), ISCHANGED(ChequeDate__c), ISCHANGED(TransactionNumber__c), ISCHANGED(TotalAmount__c), ISCHANGED(ReceiptDate__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Receipt has already been synced to Oracle. Receipt Amount, Receipt Date, Transaction Date, and Transaction Number cannot be modified. Please cancel and recreate the receipt if changes are required.
